properties.description: Manual attestation is required to validate Ensure malware detection controls are properly defined, in place, with monitoring, and integrated with incident response. (Monitoring-IR-139).

metadata.Description:
Incident Response Integration

for more details - refer to Control statement
Incident Response Integration
- Develop automated playbooks for common malware scenarios, such as ransomware detection or cryptomining activities
- Implement automated containment measures, such as isolating affected resources or revoking compromised credentials
- Establish clear escalation paths and communication channels for the incident response team
metadata.controlTitle: Ensure malware detection controls are properly defined, in place, with monitoring, and integrated with incident response.
